remarks: Welcome to 7 Peaceful Lane! Located on a quiet cul-de-sac on the Norwalk-Westport line, this single-level home provides a sanctuary within close distance to all essential amenities, shopping, transportation, beaches and schools. While move-in ready there is still plenty of room to make your own vision come to life in this home so ideally blending convenience and tranquility. Upon entry, you will be pleasantly surprised by the bright and charming look of this lovingly maintained three-bedroom, one-bathroom home. The spacious living room filled w/ natural light, w/ built-in bookshelves and warmed by a wood-burning fireplace is an ideal space for family gatherings and movie nights. The large eat-in-kitchen w/ bay window, double ovens, generous counter space and an abundance of cabinets will satisfy all your culinary needs. The French doors will lead you to a spacious deck overlooking a peaceful setting of a flat yard lined by mature trees and complemented by raised garden beds ready for your potager garden. The outdoor deck area is ideal for relaxation, entertaining, games, and fun activities. Just off the kitchen you will find the full bathroom that features a bathtub w/shower, stylish glass door cabinet, washer, dryer, and heated floors. The primary bedroom w/an oversized walk-in closet and two additional bedrooms complete the living space.The attached one car garage w/ interior access has a work bench for your weekend projects or extra storage.
